speaker: alice
text: Let's kick off the green segment because this one always gets me a bit giddy. Humpback whales are cruising past the Queensland coast right now on their way back south, and spotters reckon it's shaping up to be a cracking season.

speaker: charlie
text: Yeah I love this time of year, you get families out on the headlands with binoculars just waiting for that big tail flick. It's one of those free shows nature puts on and Queensland's front row seat for it.

speaker: alice
text: And while the whales are doing their thing offshore, the Great Barrier Reef is gearing up for its big annual coral spawning event as the water starts to warm. Scientists say it's one of the best natural signs of a reef bouncing back and getting on with life.
